guidance: Maximize reproducibility. Contrast expected vs actual clearly. Steps must be an ordered sequence a stranger can follow. Environment details must be concrete. Evidence is links or pasted log snippets only—there is no file-attachment block type. Do not speculate on root cause unless asked.

children.title: Expected Behavior
children.guidance: What the system should have done.

outline.title: Reproduction Steps
outline.guidance: Ordered steps a stranger can follow.

children.title: Step
children.guidance: Title each instance with the step action, not "Step".

children.title: Action
children.guidance: Exact click, input, or command for this step.

children.title: Context
children.guidance: Browser/OS/device/app build or other environment facts where observed.

children.title: Evidence
children.guidance: Optional links to screenshots/recordings or pasted log snippets. Prefer bullets with URLs; code block for logs.
